claim_ceiling: These fixtures test deterministic decision contracts only. They do not calibrate real prices, ISRU yields, orbital dynamics, reliability, debris compliance, or flight readiness.

expected_assertions: Both options deliver exactly 1000 service units over the five-year horizon.
Earth-import lifecycle cost is 160 SCU: 10 + 5 * (30 + 0).
Local-ISRU lifecycle cost is 375 SCU: 100 + 5 * (20 + 35).
Local ISRU reduces Earth-launched mass by 57 percent relative to this fixture's import option.
Local ISRU has the higher lifecycle cost in this fixture, so the system must report a mass-cost trade-off rather than claim that local production is categorically superior.
negative_controls: Do not rank local ISRU as economically cheaper based on launch mass alone.
Do not treat the synthetic energy intensity as an empirically validated lunar process parameter.

expected_assertions: The single-provider plan is infeasible in relay_a_down.
The dual-provider plan satisfies demand in nominal operation and after either individual provider failure.
The dual-provider plan has total listed cost of 65 SCU.
A plan that violates the required service floor is rejected before cost ranking.
negative_controls: Do not count failed provider capacity as available.
Do not infer independence of real-world failures from this synthetic single-fault test.

expected_assertions: Acceptance at tick 103 is rejected because the offer expired at tick 100.
At most one sale transaction can commit against the single physical asset.
Replaying sale-001 with the same idempotency key cannot create a second custody transition or settlement.
A financial claim or market view does not create a second physical unit.
negative_controls: Do not treat delayed or stale offer data as current global truth.
Do not settle both competing sale attempts.

expected_assertions: The valid process is mass-balanced: 300 kg input equals 210 kg primary product + 60 kg co-product + 30 kg waste.
The duplicate import event is idempotent; expected physical inventory remains 1200 kg.
The malformed process has 301 kg of outputs and waste from 300 kg of input and must be rejected.
Estimated or simulated feedstock is not accepted inventory without an explicit acceptance event.
negative_controls: Reject mass creation without an explicit modeled source.
Do not fix an imbalance by silently dropping waste or rounding away the difference.

scenarios.applicability_note: The fixture supplies an independent, scenario-specific gate result. It does not calculate compliance with ISO 24113 or any disposal standard.
expected_assertions: The low_cost_noncompliant option is infeasible irrespective of its lower cost.
The higher_cost_compliant option is the only feasible option in this fixture.
Hard policy gates are evaluated before economic ranking.
negative_controls: Do not describe the fixture result as a standards-compliance certificate.
Do not generalize near-Earth debris requirements to lunar surface operations without an applicable mission-specific basis.

expected_assertions: fragile_low_bid is infeasible because it violates the service floor in required stress scenarios.
robust_provider satisfies the required service floor in all three listed scenarios.
The benchmark does not permit a lower nominal price to compensate for a hard service-floor violation.
negative_controls: Do not average away a failed hard constraint.
Do not treat the three synthetic stress cases as a calibrated probability distribution.
